candidate.causal_limit: Representation sharing and body allocation change together as one delivery-profile candidate. Do not attribute results to byte compression alone. Final implementation and all changed allocation rules require scoped acceptance before runtime freeze.
candidate.instructions: Keep R4 Host/writer instructions unchanged. No additional semantic verifier or repeated prompt tuning. Same public interpretation rules will be provided to comparison arms.
candidate.additional_metadata_factor: New compact record truncation omits a newly generated redundant body hash only when a true full version_sha256 already exists; existing hashes and all source digests retained. Joint factor, not byte sharing alone.
